NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kindredly uses the microphone so you can record a voice letter or a voice journal page.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kindredly opens your photo library so you can add a photo or video to a private journal page.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Kindredly saves your aura card to your photos when you ask it to.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Kindredly uses your camera to make a stamp from a moment you photograph. Nothing is saved until you choose to keep it.
